title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: In one-hot encoding, each category is represented by a binary vector. For example, if the meat is beef, the vector would be (1,0,0) for (beef, chicken, fish).

title: Interpreting the Box Plot
text: The box plot shows the distribution of total costs for each type of meat. Compare the medians and ranges to understand the impact of each meat type on the total cost.

title: Analyzing the Scatter Plot
text: The scatter plot shows the relationship between the amount of vegetables and the total cost. Consider how this relationship might affect the coefficients in the model.

title: Determining the Sign of $$\theta_1$$
text: Based on the box plot, does buying beef generally result in a higher or lower total cost compared to chicken and fish?
